mathematics.assertion_tested: The transferred 2-CNF compiler agrees with direct standard-code translation, including reverse complements. Search for additional component invariants or non-Hamming detours under overlapping frames.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Finite RNA alphabet and Boolean clauses, exact integer graph distances
mathematics.conventions: All one-nucleotide substitutions are graph moves, not individual Boolean-bit flips. Each codon occurrence retains its amino acid. Pair obligations allow AU,UA,GC,CG,GU,UG. Sense translation only.
inputs: All 4^n sequences at n=6,7 for five relative frames
No pair edges and all 21 single pair edges at n=7
18 seeded compiler truth-table instances and 4 boundary instances
non_claims: No general reachability theorem follows from a negative finite search
2-SAT feasibility does not identify nucleotide-mutation components
